title: Parliament passes the housing bill
text: after three failed attempts, the bill passed with amendments that kept the density provisions intact.

title: Emissions peak confirmed
text: the statistical agency confirmed that national emissions peaked in 2023 and have fallen since.

title: Forest cover returns
text: a fifth year of net forest gain, driven mostly by land coming out of pasture.

title: Methane rule survives challenge
text: the court upheld the leak-detection rule, and the industry group said it would comply rather than appeal.

title: Child poverty falls again
text: the second consecutive annual fall, and the first in which the rural rate fell faster than the urban one.

title: Wage floor rises in eleven states
text: eleven states raised their minimum wage in January, covering about nine million workers.

title: Overdraft fees cut
text: three large banks cut overdraft fees to a level the regulator had proposed but not required.

title: The water rights piece everyone is quoting
text: a long argument about who owns a river, told through one county’s hundred-year fight.

title: What the night shift does
text: a reported piece on sleep, wages, and the people who keep hospitals running at four in the morning.

title: A library card that works everywhere
text: a state-wide card launched, and the first month’s borrowing was double the forecast.

title: The bus map that people can read
text: a redesigned network map, and a study saying riders found their route twice as fast with it.

title: Repair cafés spread
text: two hundred new repair cafés opened, most of them in libraries.

title: Universal school meals stay
text: a programme due to expire was made permanent, after uptake stayed above ninety per cent.
